'''''Melica ciliata''''', the '''hairy melic''' or '''silky spike melic''', is a species of flowering plant in the grass family Poaceae, native to Europe, north Africa and temperate Asia.<ref name=kew>{{cite web|url=http://www.kew.org/data/grasses-db/www/imp06138.htm|author1=W.D. Clayton |author2=M. Vorontsova |author2-link=Maria Vorontsova (botanist)|author3=K.T. Harman |author4=H. Williamson |title=''Melica ciliata''|publisher= GrassBase|work=The Board of Trustees, [[Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew|Royal Botanic Gardens]]|place=[[Kew]]|date=November 12, 2012|accessdate=June 8, 2013}}</ref><ref name=powo>{{cite web |title=''Melica ciliata'' L.|url=https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:407959-1|website=Plants of the World Online |publisher=Royal Botanical Gardens Kew |accessdate=9 December 2018}}</ref> It has been introduced to [[South Australia]].<ref name=powo/><ref name=apni>{{cite web |title=''Melica ciliata'' L. |url=https://biodiversity.org.au/nsl/services/rest/name/apni/125464/api/apni-format |website=Australian Plant Name Index (APNI) |publisher=Centre for Plant Biodiversity Research, Australian Government|accessdate=9 December 2018}}</ref>

==Description==
The species is a tufted [[deciduous]] [[perennial plant|perennial]] with elongated [[rhizome]]s. It has erect [[culm (botany)|culms]] which are {{cvt|50|–|100|cm}} long. The leaf sheaths are tubular and closed; the [[ligule]] is an [[wikt:eciliate|eciliate]] membrane. The leaf blades are flat, stiff, and {{cvt|5|–|15|cm}} long by {{cvt|1|–|3|mm}} wide. Their surface is [[scabrous]] and [[glabrousness|glabrous]] and the tip is attenuate. The [[panicle]] is contracted, reaching {{cvt|20|cm}} in length. The [[spikelet]]s are [[cuneate leaf|cuneate]] with one fertile [[floret]]. The florets are on [[pedicel (botany)|pedicels]].<ref name=kew/>

Both the lower and upper [[glume]]s lack keels. They are membranous, ovate, {{cvt|4|–|5|mm}} long, and 5-veined. The [[palea (botany)|palea]] have 2-veined, ciliated keels while the fertile [[lemma (botany)|lemma]] is keelless, lanceolate, with an acute apex and ciliated margins. The lemma is {{cvt|4.5|–|5|mm}} long with 7–9 veins. The flowers are fleshy, oblong, truncate, with two [[lodicule]]s and three [[anther]]s. The fruit is a [[caryopsis]].<ref name=kew/>
